text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—"Escape." That has ever captivated the
heart in every era,
the freest and most magnificent act of
all. —Gold Ship I

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The morning of an escape artist starts
early. Waking up, looking around, and
letting out a sigh.
Good grief, a completely unfamiliar land.
What to do next is—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Playing house is the only choice! Heeeey,
golden oldieee!
Wake up, wake up already~! We gotta build
a magic raft~!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"......*yawn* Morning, Golshi.
Today's bed is extra hard... and feels
great."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Journey, my morning tea, please... Ah,
right, that's not part of the setup.
Still, I'd really love a cup... of your
freshly brewed tea."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, oh, you... Please wait a moment. I
shall prepare it at once.
—Once you have composed yourself, we will
proceed with Take 2.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I managed to gather the extra
timber. How's the raft making—
...Wait, wh-what in the world is this!?
What's with this extravagant setup...!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"This is a temporary shelter personally
crafted by my elder sister.
I shall not permit this King to be left
cast out in the cold."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, it is complete...! 500 wooden
dice!
With this, we can enjoy ourselves
endlessly... Come, Orfe, which shall we
play first?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... Did you use up... all the
wood, sir?!?!
O-Our means of escape...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Gunununununu... nununununu...!!
ALL OF YOU, ON YOUR KNEES RIGHT
NOOOOOWWW!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: (R O A R)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Great work, everyone. We managed to escape
safely.
It must have been a rough journey. Please
get some well-deserved rest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... or so I'd like to say. But wasn't
our destination supposed to be a hotel?
I feel like this is quite different...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I changed my mind midway through.
This is a completely unknown island.
—Well then, shall we begin Escape Project
Part Two?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"......So in the end, you managed to
escape that island safely too.
You're reckless as always... Wait,
Orfe-san, what is that...?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"A souvenir.
It yields a rather rich and flavorful
juice. Have someone prepare it for you."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Lala, you should join the next project
too. ...Of course,
something that isn't dangerous. Let's
see... How about something like that?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"I tried using psychic powers," "I built
my own racetrack,"
"Relay race against a train"... whatever
works! Let's play together!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Stego-san and the others' video has
amazing view counts... At this rate, even
100 million is...
Fufu... The comments are buzzing with
excitement too. It looks so fun."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However, as for me...
...Should I... do something even more out
of the ordinary, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey.
...I can't get through.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"!
Ah, I-I'm so sorr...—ah!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...A video? 'Still's Recommended Snacks
#04'...
Are you participating in that commotion as
well?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... But I just can't really tell...
if the fans are truly having fun...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I am terribly sorry.
This topic... must not interest you at
all, Alv-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I cannot fathom why you fuss over
those things called fans.
Racing is... a solitary pursuit, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
And I'm surprised you haven't realized it
either.
What those who seek you truly, intensely
desire... is only one thing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Running.
—That fiery, blazing running of yours."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do some independent training
now.
If you run alongside me, I wouldn't
mind... cooperating with the filming.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Caring for each other is so foolish.
Let me teach you—just how meaningless it
really is."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, it looks fine... I think.
......Alv-san, are you truly alright with
this?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You know... that I am not "normal."
And on top of that, to be in a
situation... like this...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—Right before my eyes... a thrillingly
strong opponent. Nothing else stands in my
way.
You... might not get away unscathed...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever.
It doesn't matter to me what kind of
running you do."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just win.
...That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the one who won't get off
lightly... is you.
I don't need anyone's heart—I will freeze
you to the core.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Tsk, ah.
Haa... Yes, yes... Make me yearn for
you... so fiercely that it freezes my
soul...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us begin.
......On your mark, get set...—"
